epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the recovery rate of missing tasks from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Recover and merge the missing deliverable changes (API slices, UI slices, Test Coverages, Runtime Contracts, Recovery Data Schema, and Recovery Merge Readiness) to the main branch.
R2: Ensure the recovered code is functional, correctly patched into the existing codebase, and verified by integrated tests.

slices.title: Recover all missing deliverables directly to main
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery for this epic, I want to merge all missing application features directly, so that the exact delivered code is actually on the main branch
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the missing tasks, When I patch the missing functionality into the main branch, Then the code reflects the delivered state without inventing new scope.
Given the restored functionality, When tested, Then it functions as intended and passes validation.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease missing code artifacts from 100% to 0%
